entities.title: zazz unit tests with real builds
entities.summary: The zazz module's tests build and run real scripts, so they need the wasm32-wasip1 target and a release build of zazz-script-runner; CI runs them on Linux and the release on the owner's Mac, within cargo test --workspace.
criteria: Every test in daemon's zazz:: modules passes on macOS and Linux.
They count toward daemon's 95% branch-coverage gate.

checks.command: cargo build --release -p zazz-script-runner && cargo test -p daemon zazz:: -- --test-threads=1 (in src/macos)
checks.description: Single-threaded, so a test that hangs under the macOS sandbox shows up by name. CI's test stage (Linux) and the release's macOS build run these tests within cargo test --workspace, not on their own.
daemon's tests and branch-coverage gate, which include these modules.
